name: example-feature
summary: Add a small feature through inspect, implement, and validate stages while preserving causal relationships.

tasks.title: Map current feature behavior
tasks.instruction: Inspect the current implementation and tests. Produce a concise implementation note naming the relevant files, symbols, constraints, and existing behavior.
acceptance: Relevant implementation and test files are identified
Current behavior and compatibility constraints are stated

tasks.title: Implement feature
tasks.instruction: Implement the requested feature using the accepted inspection result as a dependency. Keep the change scoped and update tests.
acceptance: Automated tests cover the new behavior

tasks.title: Validate feature
tasks.instruction: Run the relevant tests and a focused behavior probe. Report exact commands and outcomes.
